_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::pasi#5, confirmed by execution and pinned to the knob that controls it. The parameter is WALLFORMULATION in PARTICLE DYNAMIC/SPH and its default is NoWallFormulation, so omitting it is not 'plain coupling' but switching the boundary treatment off. Deleting the single WALLFORMULATION line from upstream pasi_twoway_norelax_particle_sph_3d_piston_virtualwall_densitysummation.4C.yaml is accepted without a word, runs the whole coupled loop and reaches all eighteen result tests, but the fluid particle's density falls from 9.99658304322867730e-01 to 8.99761790578682885e-01 — a 10% deficit, exactly what a kernel whose support reaches through the wall into empty space computes — and its z-velocity flips from -2.47255596595578497e-01 to 1.36328793070252097e+00, so it is no longer held off the piston face. Six of eighteen tests fail. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep the virtual-particle wall formulation in the second arm. The density deficit and the velocity sign flip disappear, WALLFORMULATION_LINES_REMOVED becomes 0 and EXIT_NOWALL becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
